mergedParams.userDescription: Torn paper edge rip scrapbook reveal transition effects between videos

output.title: Torn Paper Rip Transitions - Scrapbook Style Video Effects

prompts.prompt: Create a torn paper edge transition preset that simulates ripping through scrapbook pages. The transition should use a custom SVG mask or clip-path that looks like torn paper edges. As the outgoing video plays, a jagged torn paper edge should progressively reveal from left to right across the screen (using transform translateX animation on a mask layer). The incoming video should be revealed underneath as if it was the next page in a scrapbook. Use a 1.5 second overlap period where the tear effect occurs. Add subtle paper texture overlay during the transition using a semi-transparent PNG image with multiply blend mode. Include a slight rotation effect (-2 to 2 degrees) on both videos to simulate the organic feel of handling paper. The torn edge should have a drop shadow effect to create depth between the layers.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1.5s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom at z-10, incoming VideoAtom at z-0. Create a ShapeAtom with torn paper SVG path as a mask layer at z-20, animated with transform: translateX from -100% to 100% over 1.5s with ease-in-out timing. Add ImageAtom with paper texture PNG at z-30 with 'multiply' blend mode and opacity 0.3. Use generic effects in provider mode: outgoing video gets slight rotation animation (-2deg to 2deg with wobble), incoming video has complementary rotation (2deg to -2deg). Apply drop-shadow filter to the mask ShapeAtom. All atoms use 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full' positioning.

prompts.prompt: Design a dynamic scrapbook page flip transition where videos appear to be taped onto scrapbook pages that flip over. The transition should create the illusion of a 3D page turn using scale and rotation transforms. During a 2-second overlap, the outgoing video should scale down to 0.8 and rotate on the Y-axis (using rotateY) from 0 to -90 degrees, simulating the page turning away. Simultaneously, the incoming video starts at rotateY 90 degrees and scale 0.8, then animates to 0 degrees and scale 1.0. Add decorative tape strip ImageAtoms at the corners of each video (using absolute positioning) that animate with the videos. Include a subtle shake effect at the midpoint of the transition to simulate the paper settling. Background should have a kraft paper texture.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with kraft paper background (bg-amber-50 or custom image). Duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 2s. Outgoing VideoAtom with initial scale-100, animates to scale-80 and rotateY(-90deg) with perspective(1000px) over 2s. Incoming VideoAtom starts at scale-80 rotateY(90deg), animates to scale-100 rotateY(0). Add 4 ImageAtoms per video for tape strips, positioned at 'absolute top-0 left-0', 'top-0 right-0', 'bottom-0 left-0', 'bottom-0 right-0' with w-20 h-8 size. Use generic effects provider: shake effect at 50% progress with transform: translate(random -5px to 5px) for 0.2s. Apply transform-style: preserve-3d to container.

prompts.prompt: Build a collage-style rip transition where multiple torn paper strips peel away to reveal the next video. Create 5-7 vertical torn paper strips that cover the outgoing video. Each strip should have a unique torn edge shape and animate with different timing offsets (staggered by 0.1s each). The strips should curl and peel away with a combination of rotateX, translateY, and scale transforms, creating a organic tearing motion. As strips peel away, they reveal the incoming video underneath. Add paper fiber texture details at the tear edges using semi-transparent white overlays. Include subtle paper crinkle sound effect triggers at each strip's animation start.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 2.5s overlap. Create 7 ShapeAtom strips with unique SVG torn edges, each taking up width: 14.28% (100/7) of container. Position using 'absolute top-0 bottom-0' with left: 0%, 14.28%, 28.56%, etc. Each strip animates with delay: index * 0.1s, transforming from rotateX(0) translateY(0) to rotateX(45deg) translateY(-120%) scale(0.8) over 0.8s with ease-in-back easing. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0, outgoing at z-10, strips at z-20. Add thin white ImageAtom overlays at tear edges with opacity 0.6 for fiber effect. Include data attributes for sound trigger points.

prompts.prompt: Create a vintage photo album transition where videos appear as photographs being removed and replaced in a scrapbook. The outgoing video should have a instant camera photo frame (white border) and animate as if being pulled up and out of the album page. Use a compound animation: first tilt slightly (rotate 5deg), then lift up (translateY -10px with shadow growing), finally slide up and fade out. The incoming video slides in from the bottom with a drop motion, bouncing slightly when it 'lands' on the page. Add handwritten label TextAtoms underneath each video that fade in/out with the media. Include decorative corner holders as ShapeAtoms that remain static throughout the transition.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-100 to-yellow-50' background. Overlap duration 1.8s. VideoAtoms wrapped in containers with 'p-4 bg-white shadow-xl' for photo frame effect. Outgoing video: rotate(0) → rotate(5deg) [0-0.3s], translateY(0) → translateY(-10px) [0.3-0.6s], translateY(-10px) → translateY(-150%) opacity(0) [0.6-1.8s]. Incoming video: translateY(150%) → translateY(0) with bounce easing [0.6-1.8s]. Add TextAtom labels with 'font-handwriting text-gray-700' positioned below videos. Static ShapeAtom corner holders using triangular clip-paths at 'absolute top-0 left-0', etc.

prompts.prompt: Develop a paper shredder transition effect where the outgoing video appears to be fed through a shredder, breaking into vertical strips that fall away while revealing the incoming video. The video should split into 12-15 thin vertical strips. Each strip should animate downward with physics-based motion (accelerating fall with gravity), slight rotation, and varying speeds. As strips fall, they should also fade out and slightly blur. The incoming video should be visible behind from the start but have a 'reconstruction' effect where it starts pixelated/blurred and gradually comes into focus as the strips fall away.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 2s. Outgoing video cloned into 15 masked strips using clip-path: polygon() for each vertical section. Each strip is a separate VideoAtom with same source, masked to show only its portion. Strips animate with: translateY(0) → translateY(200%) with cubic-bezier(0.55, 0.055, 0.675, 0.19) for gravity effect, rotate(random -15deg to 15deg), opacity 1 → 0, blur(0) → blur(4px). Stagger animations by random 0-0.3s. Incoming VideoAtom has initial filter: blur(20px) pixelate(10px), animating to blur(0) pixelate(0) over 2s. Use transform: translateZ(0) for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Design a scrapbook 'paste-over' transition where the incoming video appears to be pasted on top of the outgoing video with glue stick effect. Start with the incoming video appearing at 70% scale in the center, slightly rotated (3deg), with a white paper backing. Animate it being 'pressed down' onto the page: scale grows to 100%, rotation normalizes to 0deg, and a subtle shadow appears underneath. During the pressing motion, add a squeeze-out effect where semi-transparent white 'glue' shapes animate out from behind the edges. The outgoing video should remain static but slowly fade to 60% opacity as if becoming the background layer. Include paper texture overlays and aged photo filters.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1.5s. Incoming VideoAtom starts at scale-70 rotate-3 with wrapper div having 'p-2 bg-white'. Animates to scale-100 rotate-0 over 1s with ease-out. Shadow animates from 'shadow-sm' to 'shadow-2xl' back to 'shadow-lg'. Create 8 ShapeAtom 'glue' elements positioned around edges, animating from scale(0) to scale(1.2) to scale(1) with opacity 0.7→0.3→0. Outgoing video fades from opacity-100 to opacity-60. Add ImageAtom overlay with paper texture at z-50, opacity 0.2. Apply sepia(20%) contrast(0.9) filter to both videos.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'torn and taped' transition where the outgoing video tears diagonally from corner to corner, and the pieces drift apart revealing the incoming video, which then gets 'taped' back together. The tear should follow a jagged diagonal line from top-left to bottom-right. The two torn halves should drift apart (top piece moves up-left, bottom piece moves down-right) while rotating slightly and fading out. As they separate, the incoming video is revealed underneath. Then, animated tape strips appear to 'repair' the diagonal tear line, sliding in from off-screen with a slight bounce effect. Add paper fiber particles that float away during the tear.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 2.2s. Outgoing video split into 2 VideoAtoms with diagonal clip-path masks. Top piece: translate(-10%, -10%) rotate(-5deg) opacity(0), bottom: translate(10%, 10%) rotate(5deg) opacity(0) over 1.2s. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0, initially with brightness(0.8) filter, animating to brightness(1). Create 3-4 tape ImageAtoms that slide in along diagonal line with translateX/Y animations and bounce easing at 1.2-2.2s mark. Add 10-15 small particle ShapeAtoms that animate with random trajectories from tear line. Use 'mix-blend-mode: multiply' on tape images.

prompts.prompt: Build a flipbook animation transition where both videos appear as pages in a rapidly flipping scrapbook. Create multiple intermediate 'page' frames that flip between the two videos. Each page should be a blurred/distorted frame that represents motion blur during the flip. The pages should animate with decreasing flip speed (fast at start, slow at end) creating a realistic flipbook effect. Add page corner curls and shadows that animate with the flips. Include subtle page thickness visualization by offsetting each page slightly in 3D space. Background should show spiral binding or book spine elements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 3D perspective(1200px). Create 8 intermediate BaseLayout 'pages' between videos, each with mix of both videos using blend modes or opacity. Pages animate with rotateY from -180deg through 0deg to 180deg sequentially. Timing: first 3 pages 0.1s each, next 3 at 0.15s, last 2 at 0.2s. Add translateZ offset for each page (index * 2px) for thickness. Corner curl using ShapeAtom with radial-gradient and clip-path, animating size based on rotation angle. Dynamic shadows using box-shadow that changes based on rotateY value. Include static spine ImageAtom at left edge.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'photo scatter and gather' transition where the outgoing video breaks into multiple polaroid-style photos that scatter outward, while new photos containing the incoming video fly in and assemble. The outgoing video should split into a 3x3 grid of polaroid frames. Each frame should scatter in different directions with rotation and scaling animations. Simultaneously, 9 new polaroid frames containing portions of the incoming video should fly in from various screen edges and assemble into the complete image. Add handwritten captions on some polaroids and vintage filter effects. Include subtle physics where photos might bump and influence each other's trajectories.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 2.5s. Split each video into 9 sections using clip-path on VideoAtoms. Wrap each in 'p-3 pb-10 bg-white shadow-lg' for polaroid look. Outgoing pieces: animate to translate(random -200% to 200%, random -200% to 200%) rotate(random -45deg to 45deg) scale(0.5) opacity(0). Incoming pieces start at scattered positions, animate to grid positions with ease-out-back easing for slight overshoot. Add TextAtom captions to 3-4 random polaroids with 'font-handwriting text-xs'. Apply sepia(30%) to all video sections. Use transform-style: preserve-3d for depth.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'scrapbook collage blend' transition where multiple torn paper pieces containing fragments of both videos overlap and blend together during the transition. Start with 6-8 irregular torn paper shapes showing the outgoing video. These shapes should slowly drift, rotate, and fade while new torn shapes containing the incoming video slide in from various angles. The shapes should overlap with different blend modes (multiply, screen, overlay) creating artistic double-exposure effects during the transition. Add coffee stain and ink splatter overlays that animate in during the overlap period. Include subtle paper crinkle animations on individual pieces.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 3s for extended blend. Create 8 ShapeAtom masks with irregular torn SVG paths. Apply masks to VideoAtoms showing portions of each video. Outgoing pieces: subtle drift animations translate(random -20px to 20px) rotate(random -3deg to 3deg) over 3s. Incoming pieces: slide in from outside viewport over 1s, then gentle drift. Mix blend modes: 2 multiply, 2 screen, 2 overlay, 2 normal. Add coffee stain ImageAtom overlays with opacity animation 0→0.4→0.2. Ink splatter ShapeAtoms that scale from 0 to 1 at random times. Each piece has subtle scale animation 1→1.02→1 for crinkle effect.
